description: Search PubMed, the U.S. National Library of Medicine's index of over 40 million biomedical citations, through NCBI's official E-utilities API. Search with PubMed's own query language and date filters, pull full records with abstracts, authors, affiliations, MeSH terms and funding, or short citation summaries. Follow an article's links to similar papers, to the papers citing it, to its own references, to the free full text in PubMed Central, and on into NCBI's gene, protein and structure databases. Also matches an existing bibliography to PMIDs, corrects query spellings, and counts a topic's matches across every NCBI database. No account needed.
